message.reasoning_content: We need to determine appropriate criminal charges based on facts. The case: construction site, no permit, no safety supervision, unqualified personnel, high formwork collapse causing death. This is a serious accident due to illegal construction and safety violations leading to death. In Chinese criminal law, this would be "重大责任事故罪" (major responsibility accident) under Article 133 of Criminal Law (dangerous work causing death). Also possibly "非法施工" but the charge is "重大责任事故罪" (major responsibility accident). Also could be "非法组织施工" but typical classification: "重大责任事故罪" (major responsibility accident) and maybe "非法经营" not. The examples: For similar cases (dangerous work accidents) they used "重大责任事故". Eg earlier examples: Wu case (explosives) gave "危险物品肇事". For construction collapse, they used "重大责任事故". So answer: [罪名]重大责任事故<eoa>
